title: EMO: A Closed-Loop Test-Time Computation Framework via Alternating Context Optimization and Logits Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.22160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. translated_title: EMO：一种通过交替上下文优化与Logits引导实现闭环测试时计算的框架
translated_abstract: 测试时上下文优化通过文本反馈来适配冻结的语言模型，但普通的条件生成无法对“强化上下文更新所引起的分布变化”的强度进行独立控制。我们提出了EMO，这是一个受期望最大化（EM）启发的免训练框架，它交替进行问题特定的上下文估计（E步）和分布精炼（M步）。E步利用来自外部评判器的文本梯度来修订系统上下文，且无需访问标准答案。M步在共享前缀下对比修订后上下文与先前上下文条件下的下一个词元分布，以构建受置信度约束的logit校正。对被引导生成结果的反馈将驱动下一轮上下文更新，从而将跨轮次的自适应过程与单次生成内的干预耦合起来。在理论上，我们通过一个共享的目标KL散度函数将参数优化与上下文优化联系起来……
tldr: 提出EMO框架——一个受EM启发的免训练闭环测试时计算框架，通过交替进行上下文估计（E步）与置信度约束的logit引导（M步），实现对冻结语言模型分布的自适应调控。
en_tdlr: EMO is a training-free closed-loop test-time computation framework inspired by expectation-maximization, which alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) with confidence-constrained logit steering (M-step) to adapt frozen language models.
